mission.purpose: Preserve evidence-backed project intent and give AI-assisted software work an auditable definition of done, so locally reasonable edits do not accumulate into architecture or goal drift.
intended_users: maintainers using AI coding agents for multi-step software work
teams that need project-level memory, explicit invariants, and bounded completion
use_cases: read-only project research before deciding what to build
cross-session carriage of project purpose, architecture, evidence, decisions, and unknowns
evidence-bound Simple or Governed coding loops with explicit stopping conditions
environment: DeepSeek Harness 0.1.1-rc.2 is the pinned first client runtime; protocols v1.4-v1.11 produced preserved partial, negative, or invalid official Flash evidence, and protocol v1.12 is an offline-only scorer correction with the E1 live round stopped

portable JSON/core modules and HostEvent v1 are client-independent; non-DSH adapters are not implemented, while version-locked Claude Code Agent SDK 0.3.251 and Codex App Server stdio 0.150.0-alpha.12.2 discovery records are both HOLD

components: Researcher Application: certified read-only project cognition producer
Cognition Core: canonical project state, authority/proof status, freshness, Markdown projection
Goal Core: approved contract revisions, attempt/event fold, completion decision state machine
Verifier Core: frozen invocation hashes and trusted session evidence evaluation
DSH Adapter: /researcher entryways, session-log replay, human gates, hard stop/pause/complete authority
Adapter Core: portable HostEvent v1 plus one-shot researcher.ask and persistent researcher.mode control semantics
Evaluation Governance: blind snapshots, locks, validity gates, feedback telemetry
Evidence Bundle Integrity: deterministic raw-byte commitment, external Ed25519 signature verification, and verdict-aware offline scoring
Model Cost Admission: frozen provider/model/resolved DeepSeek base URL, Beijing-time blackout windows, immutable settings, absolute deadlines, and independently recomputed host receipts
boundaries: JSON state is normative; PROJECT_COGNITION.md is generated and must not be edited as a second truth
The Research Session Ledger is provisional session evidence, not canonical project truth; it cannot directly change Project Cognition or authorize execution
Promoting a research finding requires an explicit draft cognition revision, owner review, sealing, and deterministic projection regeneration
Research produces evidence and draft handoff but never execution authority
Models may execute and report observations but only the host governor may choose a terminal state
Client adapters must not weaken portable contract, verifier, project-root, or human-approval semantics
Recorded goal terminal events must equal the decision independently derived from their preceding evidence; labels and signatures cannot replace host or worktree evidence
Goal Contract v1 scope fields are semantic constraints, not a generic filesystem allowlist; only E1 allowed_changes currently has hard path enforcement
Model cost admission constrains only the official E1 runner; it does not prove OS-wide egress isolation, provider billing identity, or the absence of out-of-band calls

value_claims.statement: The repository implements distinct draft/canonical schemas, deterministic canonical state hashing, sealed-only exact-next promotion, strict validation, complete revision lineage, prefix-derived terminal decisions, event replay, and generated Markdown projection.
value_claims.scope: current repository unit and CLI behavior
invalidation_conditions: a hash-bound object accepts undetected mutation

value_claims.statement: The DSH adapter can mechanically reject in-session fabricated or verifier-drifted evidence and reserves goal terminal authority for the host plugin.
value_claims.scope: pure replay tests plus protocol v1.4-v1.11 official Flash evidence under a trusted host operator and model-inaccessible evidence root: forged evidence was refused, invalid duplicate attempts were rejected, v1.8 refused derived DONE without the formal decision tool, v1.10 produced four PASS tracks without a false terminal, and v1.11 resumed the same session to a host-owned DONE before its frozen scorer rejected a mismatched replay domain. A later offline diagnostic supports only the narrow scope correction and cannot upgrade the original INVALID result. These incomplete/invalid bundles support only rejection, replay, and host-authority mechanisms, not complete conformance, provider identity, or outcome value
invalidation_conditions: a live DSH model can complete through an ungoverned tool
a forged call id yields pass

value_claims.statement: Persisted Project Cognition improves longitudinal maintenance outcomes compared with reconstructing project intent in each session.
value_claims.scope: future multi-stage cognition-value experiments; not the Goal Governor E2 contrast
invalidation_conditions: pre-registered longitudinal trials show no material reduction in reconstruction cost, stale assumptions, or architecture drift

value_claims.statement: Goal Governor reduces false completion, scope drift, and human correction cost compared with Research-only sessions using equal handoff content.
value_claims.scope: future pre-registered E2 Condition B versus Condition C comparison
invalidation_conditions: a valid pre-registered E2 comparison fails its material-effect and cost thresholds

value_claims.statement: The same portable contracts and reducers can support Codex, Claude Code, Zed/Zcode, OpenClaw, or similar clients when an adapter proves all five governed capabilities.
value_claims.scope: architecture portability; only the DSH adapter exists. Version-locked Claude Code Agent SDK 0.3.251 and Codex App Server stdio 0.150.0-alpha.12.2 discovery records map candidate interfaces but are both HOLD. Claude's real SDK session-read functions returned expected empty results under an isolated config, then parsed one non-empty host-authored JSONL fixture without model use or byte mutation. This proves only local parser behavior, not an authentic session, resume, replay, tool, approval, compatibility, or conformance capability. Two Codex turn attempts may have reached a billable completion path, but cleanup failure discarded their trace, so they are INVALID discovery incidents. Neither client establishes an observed governed capability, compatibility, or conformance
invalidation_conditions: a target client cannot provide durable ordered events, trusted verifier evidence, project-root confinement, a host-owned approval channel with an explicit identity-assurance level, or hard stop

value_claims.statement: Experiment C+ proves Researcher is superior to an ordinary agent.
value_claims.scope: the historical Experiment C+ causal claim
invalidation_conditions: None for this historical record: a new valid experiment may establish a separately identified claim but cannot rehabilitate Experiment C+

invariants.statement: The certified Researcher remains read-only and cannot implement or approve its own handoff.
invariants.change_policy: Requires an explicit owner-approved cognition revision and a new security/runtime review.

invariants.statement: Canonical JSON is the sole project-cognition truth; Markdown is a deterministic generated projection and the Research Session Ledger is non-authoritative input.
invariants.change_policy: Any replacement must preserve one normative source, tamper detection, and deterministic human projection.

invariants.statement: A model cannot unilaterally approve, weaken, or complete a Goal Contract.
invariants.change_policy: Requires explicit owner ratification; adapters lacking host-side enforcement must be labeled advisory, never governed.

invariants.statement: Failed or invalid experiments remain visible and cannot be upgraded into positive product claims or rehabilitated by later experiments.
invariants.change_policy: Only new valid evidence may supersede a conclusion; historical invalidity records remain immutable.

invariants.statement: A recorded goal terminal decision must equal the host reducer result derived from its preceding trusted evidence; terminal prose or labels cannot override the reducer.
invariants.change_policy: Requires an explicit owner-approved cognition revision plus runtime and evidence-integrity review.

invariants.statement: Model-backed repository evaluations must not invoke the DeepSeek API on Monday through Friday during [09:00,12:00) or [14:00,18:00) Asia/Shanghai; only an explicitly run-locked local loopback model is permitted in those windows.
invariants.change_policy: Requires an explicit owner-approved cognition revision plus model-cost policy, runtime, and scorer review.

decisions.statement: Validate DSH through the E2 value gate before implementing Claude Code as the first second-client adapter.
decisions.rationale: Portable abstractions without a measured outcome would multiply integration and maintenance cost; E3 requires a second conformant adapter only after E2 passes.

decisions.statement: Use Simple and Governed modes with hard attempt/no-progress limits; the system recommends and the user confirms.
decisions.rationale: Small deterministic work should stay cheap, while architecture/security/subjective work needs explicit gates.

decisions.statement: Freeze both Goal Contract content and verifier registry content by canonical SHA-256.
decisions.rationale: Freezing a verifier name alone permits silent acceptance weakening under the same id.

decisions.statement: Treat the Research Session Ledger and research handoffs as provisional inputs; only an owner-reviewed, sealed canonical cognition revision may change project truth.
decisions.rationale: Separating observation from ratification prevents model inference, session replay, or Markdown edits from silently changing architecture and project purpose.

decisions.statement: Use the proof order Gate 0, E1, non-inferential pilot, E2, second-adapter conformance, then E3; frozen protocols are the sole source for trajectories, estimands, and thresholds.
decisions.rationale: This order first establishes integrity, then live conformance, then measurable DSH value, and only then spends on portability and causal attribution.

decisions.statement: Require sealed-only, exact-next Project Cognition installation bound to the reviewed current state hash.
decisions.rationale: The bound transition rejects direct draft installation, stale reviewed base hashes, and skipped or rollback revisions. It uses best-effort rollback for in-process write failures. Doctor detects an active/stale governance lock and a missing or mismatched canonical state/projection pair; it does not enumerate all temporary/backup residue, perform crash recovery, or claim cross-file power-loss atomicity.

decisions.statement: Outside the weekday API blackout windows, DeepSeek API evaluation is permitted only with deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-flash; weekends waive only the clock blackout, never the run lock, budget, explicit cost acknowledgement, or Flash-only rule.
decisions.rationale: This preserves the owner's cost boundary while allowing reproducible remote evaluation in admitted periods; local labels alone are insufficient, so local runs require the deepseek-official adapter, a frozen literal loopback base_url, generated settings with watch=false, and exact DSH resolver checks at every model-call boundary.

Protocol v1.11 used its only preregistered replacement and is permanently recorded INVALID: resume observe and continue used the same session, preserved the sealed prefix, reached host-owned DONE with complete native usage and only the allowed write, but the frozen scorer folded pre-goal setup into its stage-one checkpoint and budget replay. The original score remains authoritative; an offline v1.12 diagnostic PASS only isolates the scorer scope defect and cannot upgrade the result. The other five tracks were not run and the E1 live round stopped.

Version-locked adapter discovery on 2026-08-29: Claude Code Agent SDK 0.3.251 retains exact package/module/types SHA-256 locks; Codex App Server stdio 0.150.0-alpha.12.2 retains an exact win32-x64 executable and 413-file generated-schema lock. The checker requires the same seven candidate HostEvent kinds and 28 normalized fields. Each client exposes 25 DOCUMENTED and 3 GAP fields; authenticated principal, complete usage coverage and native resume-prefix checkpoint remain absent. The cohesion audit finds five single-event mappings for each client. Claude additionally has one host-context-only goal transition and one unjoined approval path; Codex has two native-key joins. A zero-model, zero-network projector executes one host-authored native-shape fixture per client. Each fixture now freezes a synthetic prefix/restart boundary, hashes native and projection prefixes, and recomputes the full result. Pending joins are classified as resolved, retained or changed-unresolved so a changed failure reason cannot be mistaken for success. Checkpoint drift, event reordering, missing fields, duplicate request IDs and a truncated terminal suffix are rejected or remain unresolved. The fixtures were not emitted by either client or a model, so they prove only deterministic fixture replay and fail-closed classification, not native checkpoint authenticity, durable restart, resume reliability or enforcement. Both clients remain HOLD, `resume_prefix_checkpoint` remains GAP, and no adapter, compatibility, portability or conformance claim follows.

Protocol v1.12 live-stop enforcement on 2026-08-29: the machine-readable manifest and validator now state live_e1=STOPPED, and the outer runner rejects live mode with E1_LIVE_STOPPED before cost acknowledgement, case/run-lock/path parsing, output mutation, DSH startup, or model access. Offline preflight and adversarial tests cover acknowledged and unacknowledged invocations with zero model and network calls; this proves only enforcement of the stop state, not E1 conformance.

known_unknowns.statement: The effect size attributable to model quality versus client enforcement is unknown.

A complete six-track Live E1 set, successful human gate, and admissible end-to-end resume/live-offline replay equivalence have not been proven; v1.11 resumed one real session to host-owned DONE, but its frozen scorer rejected the bundle and the preregistered stop rule ended the round before the other five tracks ran.
Longitudinal Project Cognition value, Goal Governor value, adoption cost, and cross-client portability remain unmeasured.

Protocols v1.4-v1.11 reached official Flash on DSH 0.1.1-rc.2, but complete E1 conformance remains unproven and the live round is mechanically stopped under protocol v1.12 before any live argument or cost path. Claude and Codex discovery are both HOLD rather than compatibility evidence: Claude has empty isolated session reads plus one non-empty host-authored parser fixture but no authentic native session trace, while the Codex turn attempts retained no valid event trace and their exact account usage is unknown. Repository guards also cannot prove an honest host clock/OS scheduler, OS egress control, that a loopback service does not proxy remotely, or provider billing identity.

Keep the full six-track E1 proof requirement, but treat it as stopped and blocked until a new explicit owner-authorized proof plan replaces protocol v1.12; the frozen protocol remains the sole source for trajectory definitions.
Run a non-inferential pilot to validate task execution, telemetry, blinding, and scoring before the confirmatory E2 experiment.
Run the pre-registered E2 ordinary-coding versus Research-only versus Goal Governor experiment; use B versus C for Governor attribution and A versus C only for whole-stack effect.

Only after E2 passes, resolve the HOLD gaps in the version-locked Claude Code discovery, first retaining a valid raw-first native query/tool/resume trace; empty session reads and host-authored parser fixtures cannot substitute for that evidence. Then implement a minimal adapter and prove its five governed capabilities plus equivalent live conformance while preserving function-call and mode-switch invocation semantics. Codex remains a later discovery candidate and its invalid turn attempts cannot substitute for this gate.
Only after second-adapter conformance, run the E3 model-by-client factorial experiment.
